entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A human, going by they, captain of the Seriema, who explores the strange colony Sigma's Reach and finds an artifact stone.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A Kav copilot who stays with Sami, queries the colony viy, and loads the stone cask onto the ship.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's lost cat, whose sounds Sami imagines hearing in the colony.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: The man who sent Sami and Tan to Sigma's Reach to find an artifact, perhaps to limit his losses.

entities.name: Colony viy
entities.description: The colony's administrative AI, a data network without a model of reality, which gives implausible explanations for the emptiness.

entities.name: Choprights
entities.description: A family who filled out preferences for a Sigma's Reach house three years ago but never showed up.

entities.name: Lac du Palt
entities.description: A figure whose crew Sami fears has gotten to the colony first.

entities.name: Crampton Severine
entities.description: A human author of horror fiction whom Sami keeps referencing.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: A colony on the dwarf world Sigma wrapped in membrawn, fully lit and stocked but empty of life, with traces of people vanishing.

entities.name: QA Cyst Zero-One
entities.description: A soft-walled bladder at a clay-processing shed where unidentified mined objects are stored, containing an inspection pool of shear starch.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's old fusion ship, now flying with a cask carrying the stone.

entities.name: Black stone
entities.description: A dark, oily, egg-shaped stone with a rainbow blur that whispers choosing one; Sami is touched by it and the cask is loaded aboard.

entities.name: Hotcell cask
entities.description: A containment cask into which the stone is dropped.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Tannuk's forbidden homeworld and the next stop on their flight plan.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The organization whose gift economy and viys operate in Sothera.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Summist knights whose palestar patrols Sigma and who would vaporize the Seriema if it seemed a distraction.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Zealots who might throw captured ships into Sothera.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: A ship where Sami once worked in a kitchen and where a dying voice told them they would come to nothing.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The black hole star around which the colony orbits.

events.summary: Sami and Tan land at Sigma's Reach and find a colony still in its wrap but with lights on and a dinner smell.
Sami spies into a house and finds a freshly served dinner and a house that welcomes them, though the Choprights never arrived.
events.quote: The Choprights aren't here to receive guests right now.

events.summary: Sami finds hundreds of warm, used empty slipsuits strewn on the avenue.
events.quote: There are … slipsuits. Empty slipsuits. Everywhere.

events.summary: Sami suspects the Metalman sent them to limit his losses, but Tan insists on staying with Sami and reports a cat-like sound near the mining sheds.
events.quote: Captain, I think it's a cat.

events.summary: Tan questions the colony viy about evidence of people and it gives mechanical excuses for each sign.
events.quote: They were not. There are no people here.

events.summary: Sami runs toward the mining face and sees glazed impressions of bodies in the clay, which the viy dismisses as lightning fulgurites.
events.quote: Baked into the clay. Glazed impressions of bodies, twisting in anguish.

events.summary: Sami enters a processing shed and falls into the QA cyst where a stone moves in the inspection pool.
A burnt Tannuk carrying a melted suit of armor appears, and in the struggle Sami's gauntlet hits the cask and the stone knocks against Sami, who falls into the pool.
events.quote: falling into their own dead and staring eyes

events.summary: Sami wakes aboard the Seriema under fusion thrust with fuzzy memory, and Tan says Sami fell ill and he loaded the cask aboard.
events.quote: I found you in the QA cyst attached to one of the mining sheds.

events.summary: Tan notes moxite's value has been sliding everywhere in Sothera though the mine never opened, and they head for Kavaron.
events.quote: Like someone opened a new moxite mine here.

relations.note: captain and copilot who stay together
relations.quote: I'm staying with you. Let me limit my losses.
The Metalman's artifact? The thing he sent Sami and Tan to find.

relations.note: Sami keeps searching for the lost cat
relations.quote: someone has to save the damn cat.
Sami's in their bunk on the Seriema .
dropping it like a big spitball right down into the cask.

rejected.summary: Sami tries to catch the stone in a hotcell as it whispers choosing one.
rejected.quote: The stone bounces happily toward the hotcell.
